overview: The board voted to submit a letter of support for proposed zoning amendments permitting fractional cash payments to the trust. Members also discussed fundraising and revenue options, including a state technical assistance application, and received updates on pending funding requests, the action plan, and the 703 Fellsway West project.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the November 5, 2025 meeting.

items.title: Fractional Payment Ordinance
items.summary: Voted to send a letter of support for proposed zoning ordinance changes that permit fractional cash payments to the trust in lieu of building fractional units, with staff incorporating board edits regarding payment timing.

items.title: CPC Funding Request Update
items.summary: Received an update on the trust's presentation requesting $550,000 from the Community Preservation Committee, which is scheduled to deliberate on awards the following week.

items.title: City Council Action Plan Presentation Debrief
items.summary: Reviewed city council and community feedback from the December 2 presentation of the five-year action plan, focusing on future strategies for broader survey and outreach distribution to homeowners and renters.

items.title: 703 Fellsway West Update
items.summary: Staff reported that certificates of occupancy have been issued, the housing lottery closes December 10, and a ribbon-cutting ceremony is scheduled for December 18.

items.title: Increasing Trust Revenue and Fundraising
items.summary: Agreed to prepare an application for Massachusetts Housing Partnership technical assistance focused on voluntary fundraising and received updates on resident donation inquiries, free cash research, and incoming development and resale fees.
